My name is Dr. Stacie, I’m a physical therapist and the owner of The Physio Fix, and I’m so happy you’re here! As a former collegiate gymnast-turned-weightlifter, my passion lies in treating barbell athletes and gymnasts. I have also been a strength and conditioning coach for 15 years and a mobility specialist for 7 years and this experience allows me to effectively combine physical therapy with mobility and strength training principles to get you out of pain faster and become stronger and more resilient than ever before! 

This page serves as an educational database and a free resource to the public. You will find many custom Physical Therapy exercises that I use with my patients as well as longer duration videos that go into more detail on various topics related to health, fitness, physical therapy, entrepreneurship, weightlifting, etc.

If you are wanting to work with me, I offer both in-person PT in Phoenix, AZ and remote programming and I would love to see how I can help you!
